verses.text: In the seventh month, Ishmael son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, came with ten men to Gedaliah son of Ahikam at Mizpah. Ishmael was from the royal family and had been one of the king's chief officers. While they were eating a meal together at Mizpah,

Ishmael son of Nethaniah and the ten men with him got up and struck down Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, with the sword. They killed the man the king of Babylon had made governor over the land.
Ishmael also killed all the Jews who were with Gedaliah at Mizpah, and the Babylonian soldiers who were there.
The day after Gedaliah was murdered, before anyone knew about it,
eighty men came from Shechem, Shiloh, and Samaria. They had shaved their beards, torn their clothes, and cut themselves. They were bringing grain offerings and incense to the LORD's temple.
Ishmael son of Nethaniah went out from Mizpah to meet them, weeping as he went. When he met them, he said, "Come to Gedaliah son of Ahikam."
But as soon as they were inside the city, Ishmael son of Nethaniah and the men with him killed them and threw their bodies into a well.
But ten of them said to Ishmael, "Don't kill us! We have wheat, barley, olive oil, and honey hidden in a field." So he left them alone and did not kill them with the others.

The well where Ishmael threw all the bodies of the men he had killed along with Gedaliah was the one King Asa had dug when he was afraid of Baasha king of Israel. Ishmael son of Nethaniah filled it with the dead.

Then Ishmael took captive all the rest of the people in Mizpah, including the king's daughters and everyone else left there, whom Nebuzaradan the commander of the guard had put in the care of Gedaliah son of Ahikam. Ishmael son of Nethaniah took them captive and set out to cross over to the Ammonites.
When Johanan son of Kareah and all the army officers with him heard about all the evil Ishmael son of Nethaniah had done,
they took all their men and went to fight Ishmael son of Nethaniah. They caught up with him near the great pool at Gibeon.
When all the people Ishmael had with him saw Johanan son of Kareah and the army officers with him, they were glad.
All the people Ishmael had taken captive from Mizpah turned around and went over to Johanan son of Kareah.
But Ishmael son of Nethaniah and eight of his men escaped from Johanan and fled to the Ammonites.

Then Johanan son of Kareah and all the army officers with him took all the survivors from Mizpah whom he had rescued from Ishmael son of Nethaniah after Ishmael had murdered Gedaliah son of Ahikam. These were the soldiers, women, children, and court officials he had brought back from Gibeon.
They went on and stopped at Geruth Kimham near Bethlehem, on their way to Egypt.
They wanted to escape the Babylonians, because they were afraid of them. Ishmael son of Nethaniah had killed Gedaliah son of Ahikam, whom the king of Babylon had made governor over the land.
